name: Shell Nav
job: Move a reader between the sections of a framed brief: tabs in the shell bar on wide screens, and a menu button with a dropdown under the bar on narrow ones.

anatomy.role: Flex row, 52px tall, wordmark left, tabs or menu button right
anatomy.token: none; sits on the shell surface

anatomy.role: Narrow only: the current section name replaces the wordmark in the bar
Sans, body size, semibold, 44px target, 2px underline when selected
Mono, label size, an ordinal or short status beside a tab name
anatomy.token: `surface-2` fill and `border` edge on `text-secondary`, so it holds in both themes

anatomy.role: 44px square, three-line icon that turns into a close mark
Dropdown attached under the bar, over the page (not pushing it down); full width of the shell on a phone, half its width and pinned right from 600px; rows left aligned
anatomy.token: `surface`, `border` on the open edges, radius `ds-r-md` on the free corner, soft shadow

anatomy.role: Left aligned, 44px, name then pill; current row carries a 3px inset bar

states.name: Tabs (wide)
states.note: From the page's breakpoint up. Arrow keys move between tabs.

states.name: Menu closed (narrow)
states.note: Below the breakpoint the tabs fold into the button at the top right.

states.name: Menu open
states.note: A dropdown under the bar, over the page, not pushing it down. The bar names the current section. Escape or a tap outside closes it.

use_when: A framed brief or hub has 3 to 6 sections a reader moves between (the cia and myally shell).
The page needs one section per view on desktop and a jump list on a phone.
avoid_when: A single long page with no sections; use headings and the reader's scroll.
More than 6 sections; group them first.

data.note: Each tab: label, `data-target` (the section it opens), optional pill text.
Width below which the tabs fold into the menu; the Gravity page uses 1024.
The page shows the section for a tab, or scrolls to it from the menu.

access: Wide: `role=tablist` with `role=tab`, `aria-selected`, roving tab index; arrow keys move between tabs, Home and End jump to the first and last.
Narrow: the list drops its tab roles and becomes plain buttons, each reachable with Tab; the current one carries `aria-current`, and the selection comes back as `aria-selected` when the tabs return.
The menu button is a real `<button>` with `aria-expanded` and an `aria-label`; opening moves focus into the menu, Escape closes it and returns focus to the button.
Selection reads without colour: underline on tabs, inset bar on menu rows, and the state is exposed to assistive tech.
Reduced motion drops the icon morph and the menu fade.
gates: `scripts/kit_primitive_sync.py --check`: every page that marks this block carries it unchanged.
`scripts/page_gate.py`, `scripts/token_source_gate.py`, and the Impeccable detector at 0 findings.
